verdict.rationale: Databricks docs describe Unity Catalog as enforcing access control and governing tables/columns/lineage (databricks-docs-19, -38, -46, -56, -70, -75, -94), implying granular governance, but they never explicitly document column masking or row-level filtering policies. A first-hand community comparison directly contradicts the row/column/masking claim, stating Databricks security is 'just table level, only in SQL and Spark, none in R' versus a competitor's explicit row/column-level security and dynamic masking (databricks-comm-9). Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of column masking policies and row-level filters, and independent confirmation these work as advertised.
